Speedy Delivery
Fast & Free UK Returns
Shipping worldwide
It’s so easy to order and return shoes with Sole Bliss!
If you are hesitant about ordering shoes online, the Sole Bliss team is happy to help with any enquiries by telephone on +44 (0)1923 227400 or by email on customercare@solebliss.com.
Please see below for delivery & return information by location:
It’s so EASY to order with Sole Bliss!
United Kingdom
We’re fast!
If you place your order before 12pm, it will be despatched the same day and delivered between 1-2 working days later. Orders placed after 12pm will be despatched the following working day. (Please allow 1 to 2 extra days for Northern Ireland, Isle of Man & Channel Island customers.)
Trying on your Sole Bliss shoes.
We offer 30 days from the day that your order arrives with you to try on your new shoes. We encourage you to use as much of this period as you need to try your shoes inside on a carpeted area only to ensure they are comfortable before wearing them outside. Any returned shoes that show signs of wear will not be accepted.

If you have any questions about our shoes' suitability for your feet, please don't hesitate to get in touch. The Sole Bliss Customer Care Team is here to help!
Does Sole Bliss have any stockists?
Sole Bliss does not have any stockists. We're an online brand and we ship worldwide. For UK customers we offer Free Shipping on your first order (just enter the code FREESHIP at checkout) and Free Shipping on every order over £200, so you can try multiple pairs of shoes. We always offer Free Exchanges and Free Returns. If you are hesitant about ordering online, the Sole Bliss team is more than happy to deal with any enquiries by telephone on +44 (0)1923 227400.
How do I work out my size in Sole Bliss shoes?
The majority of our styles fit true to size, so you should take your usual shoe size. Consider the width of your foot when choosing your style and size. You can read the specific Fit Notes on each style for more specific sizing advice.

about.sum:
At Sole Bliss, we believe comfort and style belong together – and we've spent years perfecting exactly that. Designed with expert podiatrists and handcrafted by skilled artisans in Italy and Spain, our shoes are loved by thousands of women – and thousands of happy feet – around the world.
Founded on Experience
Lisa Kay, Founder of Sole Bliss, has been designing shoes for over 30 years. It wasn’t until she developed a bunion that she looked into just how many women were suffering in silence. There are more than 10 million women with bunions in the UK alone! That’s when the idea of Sole Bliss – stylish shoes for bunions and wide feet – was born.
Designing Shoes for Bunions
After five years of research and development with European artisans and British podiatrists, Lisa launched the first collection of Sole Bliss heels for bunions in 2017, featuring our Miracle Comfort Technology:
Bunion Bed™ stretch panel triple-layered memory foam cushioning deep & wide toe box anti-pronating arch support
